subject: Interlocutory order rejecting pre-arrest anticipatory bail for accused Sanjay Deshmukh in INR 1.2 Crore cyber fraud syndicate.

abstractive_summary: Multi-tier cyber syndicate operated by Sanjay Deshmukh (Sanju BKC) channeled ₹1.2 Crore of retail victim deposits via scripted UPI payments into 8 Chandler Chowk mule accounts. Proceeds were instantly layered across Mumbai export shell firms before exiting to an OTC Bitcoin escrow desk. Forensic sketch and CCTV matches confirmed co-accused transit through Hebbal flyover to Kempegowda Airport.
